_comment: Bosses whose grade follows how many characters fight them (Managers.MonsterPartyGrades). Their grades
share one level and differ only in life, and a guide gives the life for each party size. Without a
row here a dungeon boss fights at the grade its room was composed with.
from      the party size that fights its first grade, and every smaller one; each character more
takes it one grade up, to its last

grades.why: Ilyzaelle's grades are 42000, 46000, 51000, 55000 and 60000 life at level 220, and her guide gives the same tiers: «4 personnage ou moins : 42 000 PV. 5 personnages : 46 000 PV» up to «8 personnages : 60 000 PV» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Belvédère d'Ilyzaelle»). She fought a player alone at 60000.
